"''A fact that is often overlooked.|Jedi Generals [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} The '''occupation of Geonosis''' was the [[Galactic Republic]]'s attempt to occupy the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Geonosis]]. Due to the Republic's tenuous hold on Geonosis and a lack of dedicated resources to keeping control of the [[Geonosian]]s' [[homeworld]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] recaptured the planet in less than a [[Standard year|year]]. ==Prelude== [[File:Battle_of_Geonosis-OTFL.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Republic and Separatist forces fight to control Geonosis at the start of the Clone Wars.]] During the [[Separatist Crisis]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used [[Geonosis droid factories|massive droid foundries]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Geonosis]] to help construct the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. In [[22 BBY]], after discovering the [[Factory|factories]] and a [[Geonosian accord|meeting]] of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] reported the threat to the [[Galactic Republic]]. In response, the [[Jedi Order]] sent an [[Jedi assault team|assault team]], who were later reinforced by the newly established [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Ultimately, the [[Jedi]] and [[clone trooper]]s triumphed in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. However, most war matériel from the planet, Separatist [[Head of State]] [[Dooku]], and the Separatist Council escaped the Republic's grasp. Thus, [[the galaxy]] was faced with the [[Clone Wars]], but one member of the Separatist Council, the Geonosian [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]], also stayed behind on Geonosis.{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Poggle the Lesser - Geonosian Separatist}} [[Gender|He]] had also ordered his [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)|Geonosian warriors]] to remain hidden in the [[Geonosian catacombs|catacombs]] of their [[homeworld]]. ==The occupation== Following their victory in the Battle of Geonosis, the Republic began an occupation of the Outer Rim world. However, the Republic had decimated the Geonosian droid factories in the initial battle,''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' and their [[engineer]]s were unable to reconfigure the factories for Republic needs. With this news, the Republic believed that Geonosis had little strategic value, so they did not assign many resources to keep up the occupation, although they did maintain a [[Geonosis garrison|garrison]]. [[File:Poggle-the-Lesser-flying.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic occupation of Geonosis was opposed by Geonosians led by Archduke Poggle the Lesser.]] However, the Republic only had a tenuous hold on the planet, as the native Geonosians fought back against their occupiers, with a much stronger resistance and loyalty to Count [[Dooku]] than had been anticipated. Despite facing a countless amount of fighting and skirmishes in the [[Im'g'twe Hills]], the Republic, also faced with the Clone Wars spreading across the [[galaxy]], were unable to keep up the occupation and needed their [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s elsewhere. However, due to Republic [[troop]]s being pulled from Geonosis and other Grand Army forces already being stretched thin to combat [[General]] [[Grievous]]'s [[fleet]], Geonosis became one of several Separatist worlds that could once again rise up. Less than a [[Standard year|year]] after the first battle, with the Republic having relaxed its occupation, the Separatists were able to amass a force and retake Geonosis. The Geonosians also used [[brain worm]]s to help overcome the garrison. ==Aftermath== After Poggle and his fellow Geonosians had retaken the planet, the Separatists and Poggle quickly and secretly restarted the droid factories, and, with an investment from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]], the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|largest droid factory ever]] was able to be constructed. However, [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] was able to discover this intelligence during a [[mission to Cato Neimoidia]],{{TCW|Senate Spy}} so the Republic planned a [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second invasion]] of the planet. The Republic hoped to destroy the factories and prevent another Separatist takeover.{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}} Following the Republic victory in the second invasion, they again took control of the world and began a [[second occupation of Geonosis]]. However, because the planet had been one of their key worlds, Geonosis remained an important member of the Confederacy in spite of the Republic's invasions and attacks. Geonosian leaders had a notable influence in the Confederacy as powerbrokers, even as battles had occurred on their world. The planet of Geonosis, however, remained in Republic hands, with a [[Geonosis Republic flotilla|flotilla]] of starships protecting the controlled world.''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' ==Behind the scenes== The occupation of Geonosis was first referenced in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Landing at Point Rain]]. However, it was not identified until it was mentioned in the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]], in the fourth image of Poggle the Lesser's biography gallery, on [[StarWars.com]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} *{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}} {{Imo}} *{{SWE|characters|rushclovis|Rush Clovis}} {{Imo}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|60|Highlights of the Saga}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' *''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{Imo}} *{{Databank|clone-captain-rex|Clone Captain Rex}} *{{Databank|poggle-the-lesser|Poggle the Lesser}} {{1stID|occupation of Geonosis}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Ocupación de Geonosis }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Geonosis, occupation of}} [[Category:Battles of Geonosis]] [[Category:Campaigns in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Campaigns of the Clone Wars]] [[Category:Conquests and occupations]]
